name: Under The Dogwood Tree
source:
21 year old Marco Castillo has returned home for the summer after completing his junior year of college.However, he is riddled with all sorts of lewd dreams about his late friend Henrietta, who has the appearance of a man now. He doesn’t know how to deal with these sorts of feelings. With the help of his friends Kieran and Clayton, he sets off to the rural part of the state to find Henrietta and bring whatever has been troubling the both of them to rest.
